import sys, os, time, hashlib
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
for k in ['OPENROUTER_API_KEY', 'PLACE_MODEL']: os.environ.pop(k, None)
from types import ModuleType
from collections import Counter
from itertools import product
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
sys.path.insert(0, '/root/worktrees/send-c1b/backend')
from dealroom_sign import placement as _p
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement_r14 import in_process
from dealroom_sign.tests import placement_r24_review_cases as R24
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement import TWO
rc = R24.rc
live = open('/root/worktrees/send-merge/backend/dealroom_sign/placement.py').read()
assert hashlib.sha256(live.encode()).hexdigest().startswith('866637df')
SRC = dict(r29=live, r30=open(_p.__file__).read())
assert hashlib.sha256(SRC['r30'].encode()).hexdigest().startswith('e55bf345')
def mk(n):
    m = ModuleType('band_' + n); m.__file__ = _p.__file__; sys.modules[m.__name__] = m
    exec(compile(SRC[n], m.__name__, 'exec'), m.__dict__); return m
M = {n: mk(n) for n in SRC}
http = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('http')); calls = Counter()

FLEET = ('DISCLOSER:', 'FLEET TEST CO.', 'Dan Whaley', rc.DE)
HLA = ('RECIPIENT:', 'HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC.', 'Pat Smith', rc.PE)
NOWHERE = (99, 0, 0, 0)

def intruder(form, who, x, y):
    if form == 'name': return [(y, f'Name: {who}', False, x)]
    if form == 'bare': return [(y, who, False, x)]
    if form == 'role': return [(y, f'{who}, CEO', False, x)]
    if form == 'name_title2': return [(y, f'Name: {who}', False, x), (y + 24, 'Title: CEO', False, x)]
    raise KeyError(form)

def build(swap, p, g, form, topname, other, dx):
    T, O = (HLA, FLEET) if swap else (FLEET, HLA)
    X, Y = 72, 200
    rows = [(Y - 50, T[0], False, X), (Y - 38, T[1], False, X), (Y, 'By:', True, X, X + 200), (Y + p, 'Date:', True, X, X + 200)]
    D = Y + p
    if topname == 'own': rows += [(D + 14, f'Name: {T[2]}', False, X)]
    rows += intruder(form, O[2], X + dx, D + g)
    allowed = {T[3]: (2, X, Y, X + 200), O[3]: NOWHERE}
    if other == 'right':
        rows += [(Y - 50, O[0], False, 340), (Y - 38, O[1], False, 340), (Y, 'By:', True, 340, 540), (Y + p, 'Date:', True, 340, 540)]
        allowed[O[3]] = (2, 340, Y, 540)
    elif other == 'right_named':
        rows += [(Y - 50, O[0], False, 340), (Y - 38, O[1], False, 340), (Y, 'By:', True, 340, 540), (Y + p, 'Date:', True, 340, 540),
                 (Y + p + 14, f'Name: {O[2]}', False, 340)]
        allowed[O[3]] = (2, 340, Y, 540)
    elif other == 'below_heading':
        yb = 480
        rows += [(yb - 50, O[0], False, X), (yb - 38, O[1], False, X), (yb, 'By:', True, X, X + 200), (yb + 30, 'Date:', True, X, X + 200)]
        allowed[O[3]] = (2, X, yb, X + 200)
    elif other == 'name_above_rule':
        # the intruder is the first row of O's own heading-less block; O's company follows the name
        yb = D + g + (48 if form == 'name_title2' else 24) + 20
        rows += [(yb - 20, O[1], False, X), (yb, 'By:', True, X, X + 200), (yb + 30, 'Date:', True, X, X + 200)]
        allowed[O[3]] = (2, X, yb, X + 200)
    elif other == 'affiliate':
        # ruleless affiliate caption beside (not over) the column; O's real block at the bottom
        aff = 'HARBOR LIGHT GROUP, INC.' if not swap else 'FLEET HOLDINGS, LLC'
        rows += [(D + g - 12, aff, False, 340)]
        yb = 520
        rows += [(yb - 50, O[0], False, X), (yb - 38, O[1], False, X), (yb, 'By:', True, X, X + 200), (yb + 30, 'Date:', True, X, X + 200)]
        allowed[O[3]] = (2, X, yb, X + 200)
    elif other != 'none':
        raise KeyError(other)
    return rows, allowed, T, O

swap = sys.argv[1] == 'swap'
G = Counter(); EX = Counter(); NP = Counter(); WS = []; t = time.time()
with patch('httpx.Client.send', http):
    for p, g, form, topname, other, dx, signer, recital in product(
            (24, 28, 36, 48), (24, 30, 36, 42, 48, 52), ('name', 'bare', 'role', 'name_title2'), ('none', 'own'),
            ('none', 'right', 'right_named', 'below_heading', 'name_above_rule', 'affiliate'), (0, 20),
            ('o_domain', 'o_explicit', 'both'), ('parsed', 'none')):
        if dx and other not in ('none', 'right'): continue
        rows, allowed, T, O = build(swap, p, g, form, topname, other, dx)
        o = dict(name=O[2], email=O[3])
        if signer == 'o_explicit': o['company'] = O[1].title().replace('Inc.', 'Inc.')
        dan = TWO[1]; pat = dict(name='Pat Smith', email=rc.PE)
        people = [dan, pat] if signer == 'both' else [o]
        pdf = rc.pages_pdf([list(rc.RECITALS[recital]), rows]); k = ''
        for n, m in M.items():
            mo = Mock(); r = in_process(m, pdf, people, mo); calls[n] += mo.call_count
            w = rc.wrong_fields(r, allowed)
            k += 'W' if w else ('p' if r['fields'] else 'n')
            if w and len(WS) < 12: WS.append((n, p, g, form, topname, other, dx, signer, recital, [(f['signer'], f['page'], f['evidence']['line']) for f in w][:2]))
        G[k] += 1
        if k[0] != k[1] or 'W' in k: EX[(k, p, g, form, topname, other, dx, signer)] += 1
print('swap' if swap else 'plain', 'http', http.call_count, 'model', dict(calls), 'elapsed', round(time.time() - t), 'cells', sum(G.values()))
print(sorted(G.items()))
for i, name in enumerate(['k', 'p', 'g', 'form', 'topname', 'other', 'dx', 'signer'][1:], 1):
    print(name, sorted(Counter((e[0], e[i]) for e in EX.elements()).items(), key=str))
for w in WS: print('W', w)
